text_en: Remember, O Lord , what has befallen us; look, and see our disgrace!
text_cn: 上主，求你眷念我们的遭遇，垂顾怜视我们受的耻辱。

text_en: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to aliens.
text_cn: 我们的产业，转入外人手中；我们的房舍，归属了异邦人。

text_en: We have become orphans, fatherless; our mothers are like widows.
text_cn: 我们自己变成了无父的孤儿，我们的母亲好像寡妇一样。

text_en: We must pay for the water we drink; the wood we get must be bought.
text_cn: 我们自己的水，必须用钱买来喝；我们自己的木柴，需要用款换来。

text_en: With a yoke on our necks we are hard driven; we are weary, we are given no rest.
text_cn: 重轭（è）加在我们的颈项上，受人折磨迫害；我们困惫疲乏，不得安息。

text_en: We have made a pact with Egypt and Assyria, to get enough bread.
text_cn: 我们向埃及伸手，向亚述乞食充饥。

text_en: Our ancestors sinned; they are no more, and we bear their iniquities.
text_cn: 我们的祖先犯了罪，已不存在；我们却要承担他们的罪债；

text_en: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hand.
text_cn: 原是奴隶的人，竟然统治我们，但没有人解救我们，脱离他们的手。

text_en: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
text_cn: 我们面临旷野刀剑的威胁，该冒性命的危险，才能得到食粮。

text_en: Our skin is black as an oven from the scorching heat of famine.
text_cn: 我们的皮肤因饥饿而发炎，发热有如火炉。

text_en: Women are raped in Zion, virgins in the towns of Judah.
text_cn: 妇女们在熙雍被人强奸，处女们在犹大遭人奸污。

text_en: Princes are hung up by their hands; no respect is shown to the elders.
text_cn: 王臣被人缚手吊起，长老的仪容受人凌辱，

text_en: Young men are compelled to grind, and boys stagger under loads of wood.
text_cn: 青年人应该服役推磨，幼童倒在柴捆之下。

text_en: The old men have left the city gate, the young men their music.
text_cn: 长老们不再安坐城门口，青年们不再奏乐高歌。

text_en: The joy of our hearts has ceased; our dancing has been turned to mourning.
text_cn: 我们心中已毫无乐趣，我们的歌舞反而变成悲愁。

text_en: The crown has fallen from our head; woe to us, for we have sinned!
text_cn: 我们头上的花冠已经堕地。我们犯罪的人，确是有祸的！

text_en: Because of this our hearts are sick, because of these things our eyes have grown dim:
text_cn: 我们的心神所以徬徨，我们的眼睛所以模糊：

text_en: because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate; jackals prowl over it.
text_cn: 因为熙雍山已经荒芜，狐狸成群出没其间。

text_en: But you, O Lord , reign forever; your throne endures to all generations.
text_cn: 上主，至于你，你永远常存，你的宝座万世不替。

text_en: Why have you forgotten us completely? Why have you forsaken us these many days?
text_cn: 为什么你常忘记我们？为什么你常抛弃我们？

text_en: Restore us to yourself, O Lord , that we may be restored; renew our days as of old—
text_cn: 上主，求你叫我们归向你，我们必定回心转意；求你重整我们的时代，如同往昔一样。

text_en: unless you have utterly rejected us, and are angry with us beyond measure.
text_cn: 你岂能完全摈（bìn）弃我们，岂能向我们愤怒到底？
